notes.title: 0.5.3.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

- Modified the Devourer chase segment in Chapter 1.
- Reduced the difficulty of the Fast Food Restaurant challenge. When one signal tower is attacked, other towers can still continue working.
-Fixed the issue where weapons in the backpack wouldn't automatically go into the storage chest after a challenge victory.
- Fixed the issue where sports equipment wouldn't be put down when exiting photo mode.
- Fixed the issue where hiding camera blood splatter affected the display of the stamina bar.
- Fixed the issue where the quick access item slots couldn't be modified while using a controller.
- Fixed the issue where the item box would lose focus and become unresponsive when using a controller.
- Fixed the issue where melee weapon attacks would turn into throws after exiting the vending machine while using a controller.
- Fixed the issue where Devourer and Predator lost attack effects after jumping and landing.
- Fixed the issue where Jodi would quickly stand up when switching weapons while on the ground.

- Reduced the weight of defensive devices.
- Added missing voice lines for injecting healing during combat.
- Fixed the issue where the color settings wouldn't be saved if you pressed ESC to close the appearance window.

notes.title: v0.5.2.3 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

- Fixed the issue where no clothes would appear in the wardrobe interface.
- Fixed the issue where scores weren’t saved in the shooting range.
- Fixed the quick weapon swap function, which would always switch back to the previously used weapon instead of the newly acquired one.
- F9 now saves screenshots from the menu interface.

- Add a fill light for photo mode

[b]If the game runs strangely after the update, try removing the mods you installed.[/b]
[b]If there is some problems with the key control, click the “Reset Keys” button in the Options - Keys screen.[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.5.0.1 has been released!
notes.notes:
Improvements and Optimizations:

- Fixed the enemy count in the stealth section, they will no longer call for reinforcements.
- In modes other than the hardest, stealth is optional, and you can now grab a bow and arrows early and proceed directly to the assassination stage.(E0 Staff Quarters)
- Removed the two enemies in the Blue Keycard room, triggering the zombie invasion event earlier.
- Adjusted enemy hearing feedback, preventing them from being attracted by player gunfire during combat and attacking en masse.
- Reworked human enemy alertness, they will abandon pursuit after a few seconds if they fail to detect the target.
- Updated the save checkpoint safety detection mechanism, you can save if there are no zombies within 3 meters of you.
- Revised the backpack system, stamina consumption is slightly increased when running, but does not affect item storage. Additionally, increased the initial capacity. (Temporarily lowered this mechanic to implement character attribute enhancements in the future)
- Adjusted the spawn rates of all zombies, optimized the experience, and reduced the appearance rate of Red Crystal zombies.
- Unfixed wandering zombies only appear in difficult and extreme difficulty modes.
- Reduced the attack power and health of Red Crystal zombies by 25%.
- Crawlers will no longer perform jump attacks if there is no height difference.
- Extended the attack intervals of the Bloodworm.
- When the generators are preheating, zombies will enter the control room, but will no longer directly block or reverse the preheating process. Instead, they will slow down the preheating speed.
- On the Easy difficulty, lowered the rotation speed of the fan that requires rolling.
- Removed the leap attack from the Predator and reduced its health.
- Expanded the combat area with the Predator.
- A new hairstyle has been added to Jodi's office mirror.

Bug Fixes:

- Issues with dragging bodies causing rolls and jumps.
- Default dodge and roll direction restored to backward.
- In difficult mode, full health will also be displayed as critically injured after loading a save.
- Issue with save files not generating zombies in cheat mode.
- Zombies without heads cannot be eliminated.
- The final Predator in the A5 rooftop fight will not move in the New Game+.
- The door to the A1 floor passageway will not open after going through the mechanisms in the New Game+.
- The Black Suit is not displayed in the wardrobe.
- Occasionally consumes stamina while aiming.
- No footsteps on stairs.
- Explosions from gas canisters lack killing power.

If you have the Saved Game in the E0 Staff Quarters, you can load it and re-experience the later part of the changes.

Again, I apologize for the poor experience of the previous version, this version has been optimized a lot and hopefully will redeem your goodwill towards The Killing Antidote.

notes.title: New Version Released!
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Comprehensive storyline chapter: (Estimated playtime: 5 hours) and 6 challenge modes.
[*] Over 230 clothing and accessories to mix and match freely.
[*] 30 different hairstyles to choose from.
[*] Customizable makeup options.
[*] 8 different weapon types.
[*] 7 different types of zombies with unique characteristics and behaviors.
[*] 1 human enemy type.
[*] Various interactive items and intriguing puzzles.
[*] Nightmare Castle is a completely randomized scenario, ensuring a unique experience with every playthrough.
[*] Challenge modes allow you to level up 20 attributes to enhance your combat prowess.
[*] Free-view photo mode.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Due to the addition of a lot of content, the development was rushed, and the Steam Creative Workshop function is not yet completed. It will be added in the next version.
[*] The clothing records saved in the playtest version will be retained in the new version.
[*] The saved game files of the story mode is not compatible because the story mode has been significantly modified.
[/list]

If you encounter any problems during gameplay, please feel free to provide feedback through the community. We will address these issues promptly.

Thank you for your support and love. We will continue to work hard to create more enjoyable content.
